description: This Java class 'DashboardService' provides dashboard summary calculations such as total customers, users, and revenue. It is marked as a Spring @Service component and interacts with repositories for data retrieval.

classes.name: DashboardService
classes.description: Service class that provides methods to generate dashboard summaries, including total customers, total users, and total revenue.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Returns a DashboardSummaryDto object containing total customers, total users, and total revenue.
